reference: Harbor Desktop 0.9.132 Beta artwork and portable profile avatars
anonymous_probe: 2026-10-25: HTTP 200 application/json, 2964470 bytes, v/art document with 6309 entries; no account credentials
bundled_avatars: Resolve existing DesktopAvatar catalog entries locally before considering a remote URL. The sampled hosted harbor_animal_01.webp returned 404, so replacing local assets with hosted requests would break existing avatars
additional_avatars: Use the explicitly chosen account server for portable paths absent from the bundled catalog. Persist that origin as device-only household artwork metadata, including across restart; never add it to account:profiles
legacy_appearance_facade: Explicit identity server also supplies the avatar origin when no household binding is present
offline_behavior: Keep shipped artwork and the previous cache when the daily index fails decoding or falls below 90 percent of the shipped entry count
request_behavior: Daily updates are single-flight and throttled for 24 hours; enrichment keeps media identity and works from local data while the update runs
